sources.ref: The gear-pricing study (docs/build-guide/studies/2026-10-16-pricing.md), from five leagues of currency-exchange prices by league day: its section 5 is the conversion table, rounded over the four leagues other than Fate of the Vaal; its section 2 gives each league's data range, whose first date is league day 0. Exchange goods stand in for gear, and the leagues disagree by 2 to 3 times, so the factors are rough

conversion.threshold.note: in divines: an item's price as seen, converted to divines at the run's rates, takes the under-10 rows below this and the 10-or-more rows at or above it

conversion.under-10.to-day-7.note: the factors that turn a price seen between league days 21 and 60, under 10 divines, into its price around day 7

conversion.under-10.to-day-21.note: the factors that turn a price seen between league days 21 and 60, under 10 divines, into its price around day 21

conversion.10-or-more.to-day-7.note: the factors that turn a price seen between league days 21 and 60, of 10 divines or more, into its price around day 7

conversion.10-or-more.to-day-21.note: the factors that turn a price seen between league days 21 and 60, of 10 divines or more, into its price around day 21

conversion.late-divisor.note: a price seen late in a league (past day 60) or after the league ended takes its row's factors, then is divided by 2 to 4: the low factor over 4, the high factor over 2

conversion.first-day.note: the league day the table starts at: a price seen before it isn't converted (its factors are 1), and the guide says the prices are from an early market

conversion.late-day.note: a market past this league day, or in a league whose end date has passed, reads as late

league.dawn-of-the-hunt.note: start is league day 0, the first date the divine traded; end is the last date of the study's data

league.rise-of-the-abyssal.note: start is league day 0, the first date the divine traded; end is the last date of the study's data

league.fate-of-the-vaal.note: start is league day 0, the first date the divine traded; end is the last date of the study's data

league.runes-of-aldur.note: start is league day 0, the first date the divine traded; no end recorded, so a market past day 60 reads as late

league.forbidden-rites.note: start is league day 0, the first date the divine traded; no end recorded, so a market past day 60 reads as late
